description: Literature bands used to sanity-check a synthesised aquaculture load profile. A metric inside its band passes; within 25 percent of the band width outside it warns; further out fails. Bands are screening aids, not evidence.

kwh_per_kg.source: Ayuso-Virgili et al. (2023) report 9.59 kWh/kg for a commercial-scale RAS; Badiola et al. (2018) review 3 to 81 kWh/kg across RAS designs, with intensive warm-water systems clustering in the lower third.

load_factor.source: Continuous life-support loads give aquaculture a high load factor compared with commercial buildings; team literature review section on load characteristics.

aeration_oxygenation_share.source: Badiola et al. (2018): aeration and oxygenation 9 to 37 percent of RAS energy; pond systems reach 90 to 95 percent (Nguyen et al. 2024), which does not apply to RAS.

cooling_share.source: Salameh et al. (2025), cited in the team literature review: cooling demand 20 to 35 percent in GCC climates.

critical_fraction.source: Team methodology: critical life-support loads (circulation, aeration, oxygenation, controls, part of temperature control) dominate intensive systems.
